correctness.rationale: All 59 A5 subgroups and 203 nonempty chains are built exhaustively from the 60 even permutations with actual closure, not a library table. All 15 C2<V4 free-face pairs and connectivity of the 57-vertex/116-edge residual graph are tested, proving wedge60 S1 integrally. The Lefschetz table is checked for each of 120 S5 permutations, and seven Specht multiplicities are exact rational inner products. Seven vertex, eight edge and one triangle orbits permit an explicit quotient collapse to a circle. Independent finite-field boundary ranks and complete executable replays corroborate each critical finite step.

evidence: Shareshian 2001 abstract explicitly announces homotopy types for many minimal simple group subgroup lattices, so it may cover A5 nonequivariantly. No S5 homology-character or quotient claim appears in the accessible abstract.
Ramras 2002 Section 4.2 proves that the coset poset of A5 is a wedge of 1560 two-spheres, not a statement about the proper subgroup order complex representation.
The explicit Steinberg representation theorems in Dupont García 2026 assume G a finite p-group, whereas A5 is simple nonabelian.

originality.rationale: The specific complete S5 character, six-constituent decomposition and S5 quotient circle were not found in exact-object searches or published records. Explicit older Möbius (-60) and possibly the same nonequivariant homotopy type in Shareshian (2001) are not claimed novel. The closest 2026 paper gives an abstract subgroup-lattice reduction but computes equivariant modules only for finite p-groups, not the simple group A5. An inaccessible older full text remains a material residual risk.
residual_risks: Shareshian 2001 exact-object journal full text inaccessible; the available abstract describes homotopy types for minimal simple groups. It may cover the 60-circle statement, which is not claimed new, and potentially contain equivariant results not visible in the abstract.

Other older subgroup-poset literature or unpublished computations could contain an equivalent outer-automorphism-inclusive S5 character or the quotient-circle result. Search absence is not proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: A5 is the smallest nonabelian simple group and an intrinsic test case of the recent general Frattini-to-subgroup-poset reduction outside p-groups. The exact S5 trace classifies all rational homology symmetry components and detects the outer-automorphism action, information not implied by the known Möbius number or circle rank. The quotient S1 reveals a natural geometry for the complete automorphism action and supplies a substantive application of incidence-orbit structure.
